pages.title: Next door · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Sunday afternoon in an old apartment building in Philadelphia. Eli carries a box up the stairs. He stops at a door with the number four. A kind woman opens the door next to his. She has gray hair and a warm smile. Her name is Gail.
“Hello! Are you the new neighbor?” says Gail. “Yes. I just moved into apartment four.” says Eli. “Welcome! I’m Gail. I live next door.” says Gail.
